name: 86 Chaos 17.1.12
label: 86 Chaos 17.1.12
notes: Moves the mobile 86Voice controller panel out of the zero-sized legacy dock and renders it as a top-level fixed surface inside the Concept 1 shell.
Forces the mobile panel open state to commit before starting the restored production Web Speech microphone lifecycle.
Preserves the 17.1.11 physical-touch activation and browser callout suppression on the toolbar microphone.
Leaves the working desktop 86Voice dock and production 17.0.29 SpeechRecognition path unchanged.
title: 86 Chaos 17.1.12
summary: Repairs the Android installed-PWA case where the microphone starts but the 86Voice controller panel is not visible.
description: Keeps the current Concept 1 toolbar and production Web Speech controller, but portals the mobile 86Voice panel to a top-level fixed shell surface so Android Chrome/PWA rendering cannot strand it inside the hidden legacy dock.
highlights: Mobile 86Voice panel is rendered outside the hidden legacy dock.
The panel is fixed above the six-button toolbar with an explicit high stacking layer.
The panel is synchronously revealed before microphone startup on mobile.
